Economy · India

Indian stock markets show mixed movement amid global uncertainties

Indian stock markets experienced mixed trading in early sessions, with the Sensex declining slightly while the Nifty saw marginal gains. The Indian Rupee also showed fluctuations against the US dollar. These movements occurred against a backdrop of global economic concerns, including geopolitical tensions between the US and Iran, which influenced oil prices and Asian markets.
